content.short: XY Finance is a cross-chain interoperability protocol aggregating DEXs and Bridges.
content.description: XY Finance enables seamless token bridging across 21+ integrated chains, helping users move assets quickly and with fewer steps. Its customizable widget can be embedded into DApps, simplifying cross-chain interactions and broadening access for a wide range of users. By leveraging composable APIs, developers gain access to a broad set of cross-chain functions to build optimized Web3 services. With routing across 20+ EVM chains, XY Finance delivers borderless, one-click swapping and a cohesive cross-chain experience.
